metadata.title: How do bound star clusters form?

notes: The paper is a theoretical study of bound star-cluster formation and compares models with cluster age distributions and gas/YSO statistics; it does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate or present follow-up of such a star. Named objects such as the ONC, NGC 6530, and ATLASGAL clumps are clusters, regions, or clouds rather than individual Galactic unbound candidate stars.
